Sandbox_Wishes_WishDescriptions_tooltip:
Enabling the wish checkbox will make the player be able to get that wish. <RGB:0.8,0,0> 
(This tickbox is merely a description, enabling or disabling it does nothing)
Sandbox_Wishes_Weight_tooltip: Forever maintains the ideal weight (70) for the player.
Sandbox_Wishes_MaxPerk_tooltip: Let's the player choose a single perk to be leveled to the maximum.
Sandbox_Wishes_Trait_tooltip: The player can choose to gain a positive trait or remove a negative one.
Sandbox_Wishes_KnoxInfection_tooltip: Detects if the player is infected. If they are, cures his Knox Infection. Doesn't use the wish if the player isn't infected.
Sandbox_Wishes_AmmoBoxes_tooltip: Spawns 5 ammo boxes of every type of ammo on the ground.
Sandbox_Wishes_Weapons_tooltip: The player may choose 10 different melee/ranged weapons to obtain.
Sandbox_Wishes_Materials_tooltip: The player may choose a stack of 10 different materials to obtain.
